name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code by Guille

plugins.name: pet
plugins.description: A pixel art cat, dog or otter above the prompt in the desktop app that sleeps while Claude is idle and plays while it works

plugins.name: turn-usage
plugins.description: A dim line under each Claude reply with how much of your current session's usage limit is used and how much that turn spent, or the cost on pay as you go
